china-1928:p0254_2.rationale: Annual silver imports into China by bars and coin, with net imports, compiled from Maritime Customs. This is trade in silver as a bullion commodity and in coin. The vocabulary has no tag for general bullion or specialie movements; silver/imports tags would be weak since the table covers both directions of flow.
review_questions: Should a tag for specie or bullion movements be added? The existing silver tag is for mining and commodity data, and imports alone does not cover the table's two-way flows.

china-1928:p0255_1.rationale: Annual gold exports from China by bars/dust and coin with net exports, from Customs statistics. Under the rules, gold exports are trade with exports and gold.

china-1928:p0255_2.rationale: Annual gold imports into China by bars/dust and coin with net imports, from Customs statistics. Under the rules, gold imports are trade with imports and gold.

china-1928:p0262_1.rationale: Monthly turnover of gold bars at the Shanghai Gold Stock Exchange, 1924-1926. The subject is the trading volume of an exchange.

china-1928:p0262_2.rationale: Yearly yen value of gold bar turnover at the Shanghai Gold Stock Exchange, derived from the registered bar turnover. The subject is exchange trading activity.

china-1928:p0264_1.rationale: Liabilities side of the half-year balance sheet of the Shanghai Gold Stock Exchange: capital, reserves, broker margins, creditors and profit. These are the accounts of a business enterprise.

china-1928:p0264_2.rationale: Assets side of the Shanghai Gold Stock Exchange balance sheet, covering securities, property, loans and cash. These are company accounts.

china-1928:p0264_3.rationale: Profit and loss account of the Shanghai Gold Stock Exchange for the half-year, showing expenses, brokerage and interest receipts. These are company operating accounts.

china-1928:p0264_4.rationale: Allocation of the Shanghai Gold Stock Exchange's half-year net profit among taxes, reserve, staff bonus and dividend. These are company profit-appropriation accounts.

china-1928:p0267_1.rationale: List of foreign banks operating in China in June 1927 with year of establishment, head office, branches and authorized and paid-up capital. It is a bank inventory, and the foreign-owned capital holdings fit foreign investment. It also records joint Sino-foreign enterprises.
